resources.string:
New Features: Language and Timers!
 		- You can now switch language from the side menu to English, Spanish or Italian. 		- Set a timer for your session or characters, helping you manage time more efficiently. Use it to control the duration of a match or any activity you prefer.


How to use the session timer:
 			- Tap the timer icon to open the timer settings.
 			- Tap the time to adjust the timer as per your need.
 			- Change sound if you like or add your own!.

How to use the character timer:
 			- Hold tap on character and press Timer to activate each timer
 			- Hold tap on character timer and use the popup features to manage the character time or use the top-right timer settings to manage ALL

The app will notify you when the time is up.
 Also you can manage those character timers with top right options

 Take control of your sessions like never before!
 Explore it now and make the most out of your time!
